purpose: Document first-party Egyptian cadastral/map custodian discovery and bounded anonymous parcel-service review.
assessment: The official Egyptian General Survey Authority establishes a national cadastral/cartographic custodian and a digital-map procurement workflow. Its reviewed public pages do not expose a Minya Al-Qamh parcel viewer, public map/API configuration, parcel schema, CRS, or anonymous ID-plus-geometry response. This is not evidence of citywide absence.
registryAssessment: Registry/custodian evidenced at national ESA level, with a separately discovered local Minya Al-Qamh real-estate registration office listing. Local open parcel-service integration is not evidenced.
